items.prompt: What must be added before calling this local capstone an actual durable portfolio service?
items.modelAnswer: Authenticated complete source/account/instrument/currency/correction protocols, independent reconciliation, real storage with transactional commit/recovery/idempotency rules, concurrency and resource-failure tests, settlement/marks/other event scope and actual runner/UI verification. A local pass or exception-order proof is not production account capability.

criteria.text: Separates durable/concurrent recovery from local exception behavior.
Keeps actual runner/UI qualification and limits explicit.
